title: Farmhouse rooms
description: The inside of a Sheaflands farmhouse: a room with walls round its edge and a wooden floor, cells of 2 m; a hearth, a table, benches, a box bed, shelves, barrels, a door and windows. Placeholder models made in code (forge 375 S3).

pieces.title: Hearth
pieces.description: A stone hearth with its fire and the hearthstone before it; stands against a wall

pieces.title: Box bed
pieces.description: A box bed built into a corner, with its curtain

pieces.title: Shelves
pieces.description: Shelves of crocks and the milk jug; stands against a wall

pieces.title: Barrels
pieces.description: Two barrels of meal and apples

pieces.title: Door
pieces.description: A door in the wall; game.linkDoor sets where it leads

pieces.title: Window
pieces.description: A small window in the wall, with a cup of milk on its sill
